title: Termini VM Allocation Request and Plan
description: Structural contract for VM allocation in Termini. `AllocationRequest` is what the frontend or AI operator submits (the output of natural-language intent extraction). `AllocationPlan` is the controller's authoritative output AFTER the deterministic guardrail/clamp validator has run. The validator's clamp-vs-reject policy, per-node ceilings, and validation order are specified in controller-api.md (section 'Guardrail & Clamp Validator'); this schema encodes the structural and absolute-bounds constraints only. Field names are snake_case. All counts, cores, and sizes are integers; no fractional vCPU or RAM is allowed. Identifiers are ULIDs (26-char Crockford base32), matching governance.md.

ulid.description: ULID: 26 characters of Crockford base32 (uppercase, alphabet 0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z, no I/L/O/U), e.g. "01M4349RPSZFTB60AVJEG0ZZY9".

vm_type.description: agent_vm = small isolated task-oriented agent (deployable on any compute node A/B). inference_vm = a REFERENCE to the always-on, host-exposed llama.cpp inference service on Node C (infra-decisions.md D5); it is recorded and surfaced in the plan but NOT launched as a VM in the demo — it is realized as the pre-baked host service (agent-runtime.md §14.2). GPU passthrough is day-2 only and never exercised in the demo.

allocation_spec.description: One requested VM class. Count fans out to N identical VMs. vcpus/ram_gb/disk_gb are ABSOLUTE bounds here; the per-node capacity ceiling is applied by the guardrail (controller-api.md).

count.description: Number of identical VMs of this class. Hard cap 64 per class per request.

vcpus.description: Requested virtual CPUs per VM. Absolute cap 128; per-type preferred ranges and per-node ceilings are enforced by the guardrail.

ram_gb.description: Requested RAM in whole GiB per VM. Absolute cap 512; per-node ceilings enforced by the guardrail.

disk_gb.description: Requested root disk in whole GiB per VM. Absolute floor 4 GiB.

target_node.description: "auto" lets the controller place the VM by capacity; otherwise an explicit node_id (ULID).

passthrough_gpu.description: Day-2 only: GPU passthrough (VFIO) is not built in the demo (infra-decisions.md D5). Any `true` value — on ANY class — is a structural rejection (gpu_passthrough_not_in_demo). It must be absent or false in every demo request.

labels.description: Optional display metadata (class C1). Bounded: at most 16 keys, keys match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$ (lowercase, no whitespace), values 1..128 chars. Never used in placement or guardrail decisions. Excluded from guardrail_audit.raw_spec persistence (only a SHA-256 summary is stored) so no free-text C2/C1 reaches controller storage (governance.md §10 rule 7).

allocation_request.description: Top-level allocation request submitted to POST /v1/projects/{project_id}/intents (structured path) or produced by the intent extractor.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key for retry safety; the same key returns the same plan (controller-api.md idempotency).

source.description: Who produced the spec. Required for audit. ai_operator = the controller's remediation loop proposed a resize/migration.

field.description: The field name that was altered, e.g. "ram_gb".

from.description: Original submitted value (number, boolean, or null when the field was absent).

to.description: Resolved value (number, boolean, or null when rejected).

index.description: 0-based index into the request's allocations array.

resolved.description: Final spec after clamp/defaulting. Present when status is accepted or clamped; null when rejected.

reject_reasons.description: Machine-readable reason codes when status is rejected.

node_id.description: Assigned node id; null when rejected or when placement is deferred.

vm_ids.description: IDs of the VMs created for this class (empty until the plan is executed).

allocation_plan.description: The controller's authoritative allocation result. outcome is accepted only if every class resolved to accepted or clamped; any rejected class forces outcome=rejected and the controller creates NOTHING (all-or-nothing).

guardrail_audit.description: Immutable audit record written for every allocation decision (see controller-api.md audit fields). Persisted server-side; referenced by plan.audit.

raw_spec.description: As submitted, before any clamping. Customer-supplied free-text fields (labels) are C1 and are persisted only as a SHA-256 summary, never verbatim (governance.md §10 rule 7).

node_snapshot.description: Registered capacity of every node in the project at decision time.

gpu_model.description: e.g. "NVIDIA L4"; null when no GPU.
